links.comparator_used: Classifiers without bias mitigation (original predictors showing gender disparities)
links.outcome: Gender disparity in predictive performance (false negative rate gap between female and male users)
links.effect: Baseline FNR was 0.082 for female vs 0.005 for male samples; the mitigation strategies reduced disparities but did not eliminate them (no mitigated figures in the abstract)
links.quote: We also proposed techniques for bias mitigation, and we could see that, even though disparities can be mitigated, they cannot be eliminated.
